limits.en: Hobby plan: limited Agent requests, access to Composer, no credit card required.

keyLimits.en: Extended Agent limits and frontier model access
Centralized billing/admin, team marketplace, shared cloud agents, SAML/OIDC SSO
Pooled usage, SCIM, access controls, audit logs, priority support

addOns.en: Bugbot code review billed on usage beyond included amount.

cautions.en: Usage-based pricing allows continued access beyond included model usage, billed in arrears; prices exclude taxes.

capabilities.en: AI-native code editor (VS Code fork) with Composer for multi-file edits and an autonomous Agent mode.
Codebase-wide indexing lets the AI reason about the whole project, not just the open file.
Access to multiple frontier models (Claude, GPT, Gemini, Grok) from one interface, plus native MCP support for connecting external tools.

limitations.en: The free Hobby plan has limited Agent requests, making it unsuitable for daily heavy use.
Heavy usage of frontier models triggers usage-based billing beyond the plan's included amount.

reason.en: AI coding assistant integrated directly into VS Code/JetBrains instead of a standalone editor.
Fast, AI-assisted code editor built from scratch rather than a VS Code fork.
Direct competitor: another AI-native, VS Code-based editor with agentic coding.

unknowns: Exact Pro+/Ultra tier names and prices ($60 and $200 per month per the internal seed) were not directly re-verified against the live pricing page structure during this pass.
